The builder applies the following default configuration:

- Port: `9200` (see `OpenSearchBuilder.OpenSearchRestApiPort`)
- Port: `9300` (see `OpenSearchBuilder.OpenSearchTransportPort`)
- Port: `9600` (see `OpenSearchBuilder.OpenSearchPerformanceAnalyzerPort`)
- Environment variable: `discovery.type=single-node`
- Environment variable: `plugins.security.disabled=false`
- Environment variable: `OPENSEARCH_INITIAL_ADMIN_PASSWORD=yourStrong(!)P@ssw0rd` (see `OpenSearchBuilder.WithPassword(string)`)
- Wait strategy: Waits until the HTTP request `GET /` with the configured credentials is completed successfully.
